description:
JPMS modularized shade of io.projectreactor:reactor-core exposing the reactor.core module.

        Reactor ships no module descriptor at all (not even an Automatic-Module-Name - the name
        reactor.core is derived from the file name), so jlink rejects it. It is a non-optional
        runtime dependency of org.mongodb:mongodb-driver-reactivestreams, which io.vertx:vertx-mongo-client
        depends on, so it cannot be avoided while the Mongo client is in use.
